title: CSCI 242 — Computer Science for Transfer Students
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and apply asymptotic notation to describe how algorithm resource use grows with input size.
Explain how loop invariants support correctness proofs through initialization, maintenance, and termination.
Evaluate representation choices for data structures to determine operational efficiency and identify possible errors.
